Run Principal Component Analysis on Trajectory Matrix

Source: R/trajectory.R
run_pca.Rd

Performs PCA on trajectory spectrogram matrices and appends PC scores directly to trajectory embeddings.

Usage

run_pca(x, ...)

# Default S3 method
run_pca(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'lys'
run_pca(
  x,
  method = c("irlba", "base", "parallel"),
  n_components = 50,
  n_cores = NULL,
  diagnostic_plots = TRUE,
  scale_scores = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A lys object or matrix.

...

Additional arguments passed to specific methods.

method

Character. PCA method ("irlba", "base", or "parallel"). Default "irlba".

n_components

Integer. Number of principal components. Default 50.

n_cores

Optional integer. Number of cores for parallel processing.

diagnostic_plots

Logical. Whether to produce diagnostic plots. Default TRUE.

scale_scores

Logical. Whether to scale PC scores. Default FALSE.

verbose

Logical. Whether to print progress. Default TRUE.

Value

For a lys object, the updated object with PC scores stored in lys$trajectory$traj.embeds (returned invisibly).
